snippet.title: Christmas Fables: The Wishing Store
snippet.description:
Do Games, the studio that took you on a whimsical holiday adventure with Christmas Fables: The Magic Snowflake brings you back into the fold with, Christmas Fables: The Wishing Store!

Welcome to Christmashire, a place where Mr. Greedy, a mayor with a heart of ice, has banished the spirit of the season! To prove to your father that you’re worthy of inheriting his toy empire, you’ll have to explore this joyless town, unravel its secrets, and revive the festive spirit against all odds! Join forces with the toy master Nicholas and Rudolf the reindeer to remind everyone exactly what makes this season so special!

Available for Game Club Members on December 3rd, 2024.

https://www.bigfishgames.com
